posts.author: Tembelan
posts.text:
Island update - lost caches & class leads
Not everyone made it back to their stash. Now and then a survivor's abandoned cache turns up somewhere in the woods - a cold campfire, a bedroll, and whatever they left behind. Sometimes it's a good rifle, sometimes just odd bits worth a look. The rough area shows on everyone's map. Get there first.

Your class now gets its own leads. Every so often you'll pick up something only meant for you - a blood trail for Hunters, a guarded stash for Outlaws, someone bleeding out for Rangers, old camps for Nomads, scattered supplies for Survivalists, a dead generator for Engineers. Only you see where. A lead has a few parts - get close and you'll know where to look. Follow it to the end for class points and whatever is waiting there.

No class yet? While we test them, you'll still stumble onto a lead now and then.

Also: world news now comes in quieter, with a short radio crackle, and your own position on the map uses the classic Arma marker.
